key_impacts: Tsunami flooded more than 200 square miles across cities along Japan’s coastline.
Fukushima nuclear meltdown occurred after the earthquake and tsunami.
Northern Japan was devastated on March 11, 2011.
evidence_snippets: Cascading disaster started with the Great Eastern Earthquake, triggering the tsunami and subsequent Fukushima nuclear meltdown on March 11, 2011.
The tsunami that accompanied the Great Eastern Earthquake flooded more than 200 square miles across cities along Japan’s coastline.
